title: Splitting a Boolean word at a given position
statement: Let $w$ be a finite Boolean word and let $L$ be a natural number with $L<|w|$. Then there are Boolean words $a,r$ and a Boolean $b$ such that $w=a\,b\,r$ and $|a|=L$.
